description: This file contains unit tests for the Duration class in the OpenMRS project, verifying the behavior of date addition operations based on durations, units, and recurring intervals, as well as testing code-to-concept mappings.

classes.name: DurationTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the Duration functionality including date calculations and code mappings.

methods.description: Tests adding seconds to a date using Duration.

methods.description: Tests adding hours to a date.

methods.name: addToDate_shouldAddYearsWhenUnitIsYears
